content: Self-publishing authors: the step that bounces most first KDP uploads is the interior — trim mismatch, wandering margins, unlinked contents, unembedded fonts. Checklist that catches it before upload: correct trim set first, mirrored margins, embedded fonts, linked TOC, one full read-through of the export. Fixed-price formatting if you would rather hand it off: https://galaxyaek7-del.github.io/openclaw-factory/customer_site/service-kdp-typesetting.html
